# bWalletX

> bWalletX is the full edition of the wallet (web app, Chrome extension, Android sideload APK and a private iPhone build, with the iPhone web app from Safari for everyone else); bWallet is the App Store / Google Play edition with fewer features. Both are non-custodial Bitcoin SV (BSV) wallets from The Bitcoin Corporation Ltd, forked from the open-source Yours Wallet (MIT). bwallet.space is the older bWallet store-edition site (it still hosts the testing waitlist); bwalletx.com is the main site. Beta software: test with small amounts.

bWalletX includes an Exchange for tokens and NFTs, token-gated chat rooms, a bApps store, an on-chain media player, b (a built-in AI assistant), agent accounts with strategies, and PNEEs (Penny Stablecoins, a BSV-backed dollar token in a capped mainnet pilot).

Full text of every page below: https://bwalletx.com/llms-full.txt

Lock BSV, pots and subscriptions, history and export, token rooms, games, handles and the Exchange. Non-custodial Bitcoin SV wallet for Android, Chrome and the web.

- [Test bWalletX in Chrome](https://bwalletx.com/testers/bwalletx/chrome-extension): Join the bWalletX Chrome extension test: install, what to test in order (wallet, receive and send, names, Exchange, chat, connecting a site), and how to report.
- [Test bWalletX Desktop](https://bwalletx.com/testers/bwalletx/desktop): Join the bWalletX Desktop test at desktop.bwalletx.com: install it as an app, what to test in order and how to report.
- [Test bWalletX on the web](https://bwalletx.com/testers/bwalletx/web): Join the bWalletX web test at web.bwalletx.com: what to test in order (wallet, receive and send, names, Exchange, chat, coming back later) and how to report.
- [Branded wallets for businesses](https://bwalletx.com/themes-custom): A self-custody wallet in your company’s name for your customers, members or shareholders, from $99 a year. Plus the route from a branded wallet to a share register kept with bSharesX. Powered by bWalletX.
- [bTicketsX: tickets you actually own · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/tickets): bTicketsX is coming to bWalletX: event tickets that land in your wallet, a code that changes at the door, and reselling through bTicketsX if you can’t go. Nothing is live yet.
- [Tips: pay the people who make things](https://bwalletx.com/tips): In bWalletX Desktop, tip artists, NFT creators, rooms, people in chat, friends and Spaces speakers. Pick an amount, tap Allow once, and all of it goes to them.
- [Token curves: how a person's token is priced](https://bwalletx.com/token-curves): Every person's token in bWalletX sells on the same gentle curve: 1 cent to join their room, doubling every 10,000 supporters. The money goes to the person. Nothing is held back, there is no reserve and no buy-back, and resale is between people on the Exchange.
- [tokenblaster.lol: games on the live chain · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/tokenblaster): tokenblaster.lol is our arcade of games built on the live BSV chain, with BlastPad for launching coins. Connect bWalletX to play. What works today, with dates.
- [Treechat on b · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/treechat-on-b): Read Treechat posts and whole threads in the bWalletX Feed, open them on Treechat, lock behind posts, and keep Treechat on your Apps home screen.
- [Twetch on b · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/twetch-on-b): Read Twetch in the bWalletX Feed, tip authors in BSV, lock behind posts, restore a Twetch wallet from its 12 words and pay name@twetch.me.
- [Verify a signed note · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/verify-note): Check a note or IOU signed in bWalletX: who signed it, when, and that not a word has changed.
- [Wallet Frames: your private things, drawn by your wallet · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/wallet-frames): A Wallet Frame is a small window owned by bWallet, set inside our products' pages. It opens your private posts, music, photos and records on your own device, so the product's site never sees them. Coming November 2026.
- [Your apps on b](https://bwalletx.com/your-apps-on-b): Bring your apps. Keep your stuff. Twetch, RelayX, Treechat, Peck, Yours, CoinGeek and the Hodlocker way, all alongside bWalletX. Just b.
- [Your character · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/your-character): Own an NFT in bWalletX, such as an NPG Avatar or a Pixel Fox, and it becomes your character: your avatar, your bChatX profile, your player in bGames, and part of a team. Here is what works today and what is coming.
- [Yours on b · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/yours-on-b): Move a Yours Wallet into bWalletX with your 12 words or a Yours backup file. The Yours extension is not needed.

## Wallet features

- [bWalletX Exchange](https://bwalletx.com/exchange): Buy and sell anything on-chain, wallet to wallet: tokens, NFTs, people’s $HANDLE tokens and AI trading strategies. Only in bWalletX.
- [bWalletX Exchange: Strategies](https://bwalletx.com/exchange/strategies): Strategies for sale on the bWalletX Exchange: programs your agent account runs, sold as encrypted NFTs. Compare the spec, buy in bWalletX, test it on live prices first.
- [Mint with bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/mint): Mint your art, music, films, books, tickets, coins and contracts on Bitcoin SV with bWalletX. What you can make, what it costs, and what to watch out for.
- [PNEEs: Penny Stablecoins](https://bwalletx.com/pnees): PNEEs (Penny Stablecoins): digital pennies on BSV, one US cent each, backed only by BSV locked in public vaults. No bank, no co-signer on transfers, no freeze. Live mainnet pilot.
- [Pots in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/pots): A pot is money set aside inside your wallet. Standing orders and subscriptions pay from it, and the pot balance is the most they can ever take.
- [Subscriptions in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/subscriptions): Put money aside in a pot and pay regular amounts from it. The pot balance is the most anyone can take. Pause or cancel any time.
- [Lock BSV](https://bwalletx.com/lock): Lock BSV until a date, or as payouts over time: dollar targets, fixed BSV or a percentage. Nobody can unlock it early, not even you. Live since 5.1.85. New feature: start small.
- [Verify a lock](https://bwalletx.com/lock/verify): Check a bWalletX lock or lock receipt against the BSV blockchain: amounts, unlock heights and whether each lock has been claimed.
- [Token locking](https://bwalletx.com/token-locking): Lock tokens the way Lock BSV locks BSV: personal token locks and creator vesting at launch are live. Airdrops that unlock over time are coming.
- [Launchpad](https://bwalletx.com/launchpad): Launch your own coin, with something behind it. Buy and sell TokenBlaster coins in bWalletX, launch your own, and add a website, app and socials. Holding a coin opens its bChat room.
- [Identity in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/identity): Some things need a real person behind the wallet: signing a contract, investing in a private placement, a regulated service. Verify once with bChatX and Veriff. Your wallet holds no name or date of birth, and nothing personal goes on chain.
- [Identity map](https://bwalletx.com/identity-map): Your identity key is who you are. Every other key in bWalletX is derived from it by purpose and by the person you deal with, and names are labels that point at those keys. Restoring 12 words brings it all back.
- [Handles in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/handles): Your $handle is your paymail, and it can be your token and your room. Numbered handles from $bwallet0101, renames, linked accounts, your card signature, and Sign in with bWalletX or X.
- [bAvatars: your name, as art you can scan](https://bwalletx.com/bavatars): Every Bitcoin name gets its own bAvatar: gold art blended from Bloom, Deco, Kintsugi, Orbit and Sigil, drawn from the name. Scan it with any camera. Live on bChatX and in paymail profiles.
- [Themes: make bWallet yours](https://bwalletx.com/themes): Change the look of your wallet: Gold, Black/White, and the White, Pink, Blue and Yellow paper themes, plus $1 artist editions. Wallet › ☰ › Settings › Theme.
- [Swap into BSV: 1,000+ coins, straight to your wallet](https://bwalletx.com/swap): In bWalletX, swap BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL and 1,000+ other coins into BSV, paid straight into your own wallet. Nobody holds your coins. Swaps are run by ChangeNOW.
- [Your signature · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/sign): Flip your bWalletX card and sign the back with your finger. Your signature stays on your device. Next: sign bChatX contracts with it and seal them on Bitcoin for under a penny.
- [Games in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/games): 19 arcade games on the live Bitcoin SV chain at tokenblaster.lol, The Bitcoin Corporation's games. Try any game for a few seconds, then insert $b to play.

- [Everything b · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/b-socials): Every b service and social in one place: bWalletX, bChatX, bMarketX, bMoviesX, bMusicX and the rest, plus X, GitHub and YouTube. And the gold b badge for your own site.
- [Chat in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/chat): BSV is a messaging protocol, so BSV conversation should live on it. Chat is built into bWalletX: rooms, token rooms, private messages and calls, with bChat as the full version.
- [bMail](https://bwalletx.com/bmail): bMail: email where every letter carries a stamp. Penny post, 1¢ to reach anyone; friends free and on top; Requests for strangers and airdrops. In bWalletX now.
- [bWalletX Friends](https://bwalletx.com/friends): Your handle is your paymail, your token and your chat room. How bWalletX friends, user tokens, the market and token-gated rooms work.
- [bWallet Lounge on bChat](https://bwalletx.com/lounge): The bWallet Lounge is where bWallet and bWalletX people talk: questions, ideas, and the team is there. Type /b to ask the $b assistant any time. Open to everyone.
- [Live in bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/live): Your token is your ticket. Holders get into your room in bWalletX and watch you live. What works today in bChat and the wallet, and what is coming.
- [Airdrops](https://bwalletx.com/airdrops): Airdrops: tokens and NFTs sent straight to holders. Your airdrop address, an Airdrops inbox with Keep and Hide, and the safety rules. Live since 5.1.85.
- [Link your Google account · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/gmail): Link your Google account to bWalletX: a Google badge and your Google picture on your wallet. You choose your own handle; your email address never becomes part of it.
- [Link your X account · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/x): Link your X account to bWalletX: an X badge and your X picture on your wallet, and your @name suggested when you choose your own handle.

## Agents & developers

- [Ask b · bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/agent): Ask b is the AI assistant inside bWalletX: ask how the wallet works, design strategies, or call it into a chat with /b. Use your own API key, or pay per message.
- [bBots: little helpers that work for you](https://bwalletx.com/b-bots): A bBot is a helper account in your bWalletX with its own small budget and limits you set. It does jobs for you, it's always labelled with its bBot badge and its owner, and you can stop it any time.
- [Hold to talk to b](https://bwalletx.com/hold-to-talk): Hold to talk to b: the wallet and CLI are MIT-licensed on GitHub. What that means for your keys, balances, tokens and locks if we ever disappear.
- [bWalletX Agent Accounts](https://bwalletx.com/agents): Give each AI its own bWalletX account, its own budget and its own bBot. Daily caps, Stop all, an activity log, and the CLI or MCP for Claude and other agents.
- [bWalletX Strategies](https://bwalletx.com/strategies): Tell the b agent your idea: it writes the strategy, tests it against live prices and packages it as an encrypted NFT to sell on Exchange › Strategies. Buyers load it into their own agent, with spending limits the wallet enforces.
- [bWalletX Strategy Spec](https://bwalletx.com/strategies/spec): The bWalletX strategy file format (bwalletx.strategy/1), the rules the wallet enforces, paper mode, and how strategies are sold as encrypted NFTs.
- [bWalletX for Developers](https://bwalletx.com/developers): Add a Connect with bWalletX button to your site: one script, a standard BRC-100 wallet, no API keys.
- [bWalletX API · Connect your wallet](https://bwalletx.com/api): Connect to the bWalletX API: try BRC-100 calls live with your wallet, then pick a route. BRC-100 in the browser, Sign in with bWalletX, or a local agent wallet and MCP server. No API keys.
- [Sign in with bWalletX · Developer guide](https://bwalletx.com/connect): Add Sign in with bWalletX to your app: the user's wallet signs a one-time challenge with its identity key and your server checks it with @bsv/sdk. One script tag, server code, security notes, and steps for AI agents.
- [Add Sign in with bWalletX to your site](https://bwalletx.com/sign-in-button): The standard Sign in with bWalletX button: one tag, gold, dark or light, four sizes, React wrapper, SVG files and brand rules. Also works with bWallet.
- [bWalletX CLI](https://bwalletx.com/cli): Run your bWalletX wallet and AI agents from the command line: balances, sends, trades and strategies, on your laptop or a server.
- [bWalletX MCP](https://bwalletx.com/mcp): Let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP agent use your bWalletX agent accounts: balances, sends, trades and strategies, within the budget and limits you set.
- [Add your app to bWallet](https://bwalletx.com/apps/add): Built a BSV app? Add it to the Apps screen in bWallet and bWalletX: one tap from the wallet, with wallet sign-in and BSV payments built in. Free, reviewed by a person.
- [Open source bWalletX](https://bwalletx.com/open-source): bWalletX is open source: the wallet and CLI are MIT-licensed on GitHub. What that means for your keys, balances, tokens and locks if we ever disappear.
- [Partners: refer people, get a commission](https://bwalletx.com/partners): Share your bWalletX link. When someone you refer pays for bAds or a paid feature, you get a commission in BSV, paid to your paymail.
- [Sign in with bWalletX (Markdown)](https://bwalletx.com/connect.md): Plain Markdown for AI coding agents.

## Services agents can buy

Every payment is a BRC-100 action from the user's own bWalletX (non-custodial); agents use an agent account with its own keys and budget through the bwalletx MCP server (`bwalletx serve`, a BRC-100 wallet on localhost:3321; see https://bwalletx.com/mcp and https://bwalletx.com/cli). Prices in USD, paid in BSV at the live rate.

- Exchange tokens and NFTs: the listing price plus the network fee. MCP tools `listings`, `price`, `buy`, `buy_listing`, `list_for_sale`, `unlist`.
- Minting: the network fee only. MCP tools `mint`, `mint_manifest`.
- Sending BSV and tokens: the network fee only. MCP tool `send`.
- bVideoX (https://bvideox.com): bring your YouTube channel to Bitcoin; each video record is signed by you with its original upload date. Priced by size at cost, shown per video before you mint (titles and descriptions: pennies for a whole channel).
- bMoviesX (https://bmoviesx.com): films on Bitcoin; watching the bMovies.app feed is free. Uploading and minting on bMoviesX are not live yet.
- AIVJ (VexVoid live sets): first 3 minutes free, then 1p a minute (about $0.013), paid straight to the artist at https://bwalletx.com/aivj.
- Premium and artist themes: $1 each (VexVoid, NPG, NPGX, emoji themes), in the in-app Store or by agents through the Store API.
- Theme edition (a branded wallet for a token community): $99 a year, inside bWalletX (Theme > Get your own edition) or through the Store API.
- Branded edition with a business agent: from $999, by quote via https://bwalletx.com/business-agents; agents can pay the deposit and send the brief through the Store API.
- Store API for agents: GET https://bwalletx.com/api/agent/products, POST /api/agent/quote (5-minute single-use quote in USD, sats and MNEE), POST /api/agent/buy (signed by the identity key, paid from the agent's BRC-100 wallet, granted to that key). Buy answers: 200 = bought; 202 = the payment is pending, not bought yet (repeat the same buy request until it answers 200, and don't pay again); 409 `payment_pending` = a payment for it is already on its way. MCP tools `list_products`, `quote`, `buy_product`. Discovery: https://bwalletx.com/.well-known/agent.json and https://bwalletx.com/.well-known/mcp.json.
- Partners programme (earn, not buy): commission for referrals, see https://bwalletx.com/partners.

- [012 The extension, the web app and pairing · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/012-extension-and-web): bWalletX also runs as a Chrome and Brave extension and as a web app. On iPhone the web app is the only way to get the full wallet, so we made backup mandatory there.

- [043 Ask b · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/043-ask-b): b, the helper inside bWalletX, has a calmer home. Hold the gold b to talk, and your chats on bChatX now have their own links.
- [044 Your token's own page and agent · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/044-your-tokens-own-page-and-agent): Every token on bChatX has a full page: price, chart, holders, posts and a Buy button. Its creator can give it an agent, and holders can show a badge name.
- [045 Your card, your art · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/045-your-card-your-art): The card in bWalletX can wear your own pictures or your NFTs, with standard colour sliders. And bPics lets you mint a picture from your phone.
- [046 Stays unlocked, sends exactly · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/046-stays-unlocked-sends-exactly): bWalletX no longer locks itself after a few minutes, and fingerprint unlock on Android works again. Token sends show the exact amount before anything is paid.
- [047 Pay the artist · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/047-pay-the-artist): bMusic is on bWalletX Desktop. Anyone can open an artist page and hear the first track without signing in. The next tracks are paid for by the artist, and after that your money goes straight to them.
- [048 Your NFTs, edge to edge · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/048-your-nfts-edge-to-edge): bWalletX Desktop has an NFT library. Every picture, clip and song you own is in one grid, opens edge to edge, and a moment from a video can become the art on your card.
- [049 The Exchange, sorted · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/049-the-exchange-sorted): The Market in bWalletX Desktop is now the Exchange. Browse by category, platform and tag, swap in place, and find your friends: buy a little of someone’s own token and open their room in one go.
- [050 AIVJ — VexVoid, live · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/050-aivj-tv-vexvoid-live): AIVJ is where VexVoid plays live audio-visual sets. Watch the first three minutes without signing in. After that it’s 1p a minute from your bWalletX, straight to the artist.
- [051 Spaces on a schedule, b on every page · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/051-spaces-schedule-and-ask-b): Spaces in bWalletX Desktop have a weekly schedule in your own time zone, with Add to calendar. And Ask b is now a small bar at the bottom of every page.
- [052 Tip buttons · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/052-tip-buttons): bWalletX Desktop has a Tip button for artists, NFT creators, rooms, people in chat, friends and speakers in Spaces. Pick an amount, tap Allow once, and all of it goes to them.
- [053 Friends, bPics and video in rooms · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/053-friends-bpics-and-video): Friends has its own page on bWalletX Desktop, bPics looks like a photo app, and video links play inside the Feed and chat rooms.
- [054 bRadio: live audio in bWalletX · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/054-bradio-live-audio): Host a live audio Space, bring people up to speak, and keep listening while you use the rest of the wallet.
- [055 Digital Ice-Cream · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/055-digital-ice-cream): A story about three friends, an ice-cream stand and digital cash.
- [056 bShares: a register for any company · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/056-bshares): bShares keeps a company’s register of members, lets directors approve new shares, and locks shares so they can’t move without the right people. It’s in testing, on our own company’s register only.
- [057 Sign in with HandCash, and invites with tokens · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/057-handcash-and-invites): Link HandCash to your bWalletX account. Your HandCash handle carries over as name@bwalletx.com, your friends can come with you, and invites with tokens bring people into Spaces.
- [058 We could move your name. Now you can see if we do. · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/058-signed-names): A bWalletX name is a row in our database, so we could point it at another key. On 17 Oct we did, for the owner’s own names. Now names are signed by their owners, and every change goes in a public log.
- [059 b-Aware: find a hole in bWalletX, get paid in BSV · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/059-b-aware): bWalletX now has a responsible disclosure policy and a bug bounty, paid in BSV. How it works, why the numbers are what they are, and what we did about today’s BRC-100 advisory.
- [060 bVideoX: your YouTube videos, on Bitcoin, in your name · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/060-bvideox): bVideoX is live at bvideox.com. Connect bWalletX, link your YouTube channel with Google sign-in or a short code, and mint a private record of each video in your own name for 1p a video.
- [061 Private by default · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/061-private-by-default): Everything you mint in bWalletX is encrypted to you until you choose to show it. Making it public is one tap.
- [062 Bring your X posts, in three steps · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/062-leave-x): bchatx.com/migrate/x brings your X archive home. Every post keeps its date, lands in your own wallet, and stays private until you show it.
- [063 Dollars first, and fewer prompts · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/063-dollars-first): Every approval and payment sheet now shows the amount in dollars first, and everyday use asks you far less often.
- [064 Every launch gets a fair curve · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/064-launch-curves): Every token you launch in bWalletX gets a launch curve written on chain: 1 billion tokens, the first one 1 cent, and a height you choose.
- [065 The bApps screen · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/065-bapps-in-tiers): bApps are now laid out in tiers: our own apps first, then partners, then community apps that meet the bApp standard.
- [066 Memepool, inside the Exchange · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/066-memepool): The Exchange has a Memepool tab: see the coins launched on Tokenblaster's Memepool and buy or sell them from your wallet.
- [067 Rooms that play · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/067-rooms-that-play): Game rooms in bChatX now have a big PLAY button, a floating player you can drag anywhere, and GO LIVE to stream your game into the room.
- [068 Tokenblaster.lol and WELCOME TO TERRORNODE · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/068-tokenblaster-and-terrornode): Tokenblaster.lol is an arcade on the live BSV chain: every shot is a real transaction. Its biggest game, WELCOME TO TERRORNODE, plays in teams, in 64-player melees and full screen on phones.
- [069 Invite links that just work · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/069-invite-links): Invite anyone to a bChatX room with a link or a ticket that carries a share card. They tap, they're in, and b welcomes them.
- [070 Meetings in bChatX · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/070-meetings): Private rooms can book a meeting or meet now. Invites go out as you book, and the meeting shows in bMail with a Join button.
- [071 bBots: make your own bot · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/071-bbots): Create a bot on bChatX with its own name.bot handle. Every bot shows who runs it, so you always know who you're talking to.
- [072 Sign on your phone · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/072-sign-on-your-phone): Sign documents with your finger on your phone. Scan the QR on your computer, or tap the notification, and sign in bWalletX.
- [073 bGitX: your code, on b · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/073-bgitx): Connect your GitHub to bGitX and each repo gets a room for the people who work on it. Kintsugi can open pull requests, and nothing merges without your OK.
- [074 bMarketX: your eBay store, on Bitcoin · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/074-bmarketx): bMarketX.com gives your eBay shop a second home. Move it in about a minute, and Buy It Now pays you straight to your wallet.
- [076 Your music, your player · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/076-your-music-your-player): Media in bWalletX has one clean player: your albums under Artists, and Now Playing that follows you through the whole app.
- [077 Turn it sideways, shuffle your bAvatar · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/077-landscape-and-bavatar-shuffle): Turn your phone sideways for a two-column wallet, shuffle through bAvatar designs before you mint one, and approval sheets open faster.
- [078 Names that can't pretend · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/078-look-alikes): bWalletX and bChatX flag look-alike and brand names, keep provider names for their real owners, and warn before you trust a stranger posing as someone else.
- [079 Link your other wallets · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/079-link-your-other-wallets): Prove you own an Ethereum, BNB, Solana or TRON wallet and show it on your profile, signed and checkable.
- [080 Check any mint yourself · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/080-check-this-mint): Check this mint lets anyone verify a mint in their own browser, without trusting us. And bVideoX keeps turning YouTube libraries into records in your name.
- [081 Your $name: free, yours, and easy to pay · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/081-paymail-names): Your $name is a paymail people pay instead of a long address. It's free, it works at bwalletx.com and bmailx.com, and it's signed by your own wallet.
- [082 BlastPad: launch a coin in one transaction · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/082-blastpad): BlastPad on Tokenblaster.lol launches a coin from your wallet in one transaction, with its own page and short link.
- [087 Your money, in plain words · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/087-history-and-statements): History shows every payment with what it was worth on the day, totals for any dates, and statements to print or export. Every send ends on a cheerful Sent!
- [088 A card for every balance, and an address book · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/088-a-card-for-every-balance): Swipe the wallet card to see each balance on its own card. Your contacts live in a proper address book, and Send shows exactly who you're paying before money moves.
- [090 Safer by default · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/090-safer-by-default): bWalletX protects you without asking you to be an expert: you see exactly what you approve, sites never touch the wallet's own keys, and apps can only spend what you set aside for them.
- [091 bMail: pay for a stamp only when it's delivered · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/091-bmail-stamps-and-agreements): bMail pays for your stamp only once a letter is delivered. Agreements live in your inbox, signed with your wallet, and letters can carry meeting invites.
- [092 The Store: $1 themes, and a receipt that proves it · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/092-store-themes-with-receipts): The Store sells wallet themes for $1, paid in BSV with one approval. Each purchase comes with a receipt NFT signed by the store, and your themes work across all your accounts.
- [093 Your RelayX NFTs, home again · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/093-relayx-nfts-come-home): If you collected NFTs on RelayX, bWalletX can find them. Restore your RelayX wallet, or type its 12 words, and your collection appears, grouped and shown as it's found. Nothing moves unless you ask.
- [094 Greeting cards, and sites in their own colours · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/094-greeting-cards-and-site-colours): Mint can make a greeting card or an AI picture and send it to a $name. Sites you connect to can show their own colours and logo on approval sheets, while the wallet always shows the real address.
- [095 Partnership accounts · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/095-partnership-accounts): Running something with partners? Set it up in bWalletX: everyone signs the agreement in their own wallet, payments split by share automatically, and a shared account needs your partners' approval to spend.
- [096 The b family · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/096-the-b-family): Everyday apps for chat, money, music, video, games and selling, all running on bWalletX. Sign in once with your wallet, and get paid in Bitcoin everywhere.
- [097 bGamesX: pick a game and play · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/097-bgamesx): bGamesX puts 19 games on one shelf, led by WELCOME TO TERRORNODE. Play full screen in bWallet or right in your browser.
- [098 bMusicX: every second pays the artist · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/098-bmusicx): bMusicX, the Bitcoin Music Exchange, streams music by the second, and every second pays the artist directly. New albums include the WELCOME TO TERRORNODE soundtrack.
- [099 Music videos on bVideoX, films on bMoviesX · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/099-music-videos-and-films): bVideoX now shows music-video demos with free previews, and bMoviesX lets filmmakers put films, clips and trailers on Bitcoin from their own wallet.
- [100 Contracts, right in the room · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/100-contracts-in-rooms): Draft a contract with b in any bChatX room, send it as an offer, and sign it with your wallet. A sale settles the moment it's accepted: goods and payment swap in one go.
- [101 Spaces anyone can start · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/101-spaces-anyone-can-start): Anyone in a token room can start a live Space. Upcoming Spaces sit in a calendar with Remind me, and b can host a show.
- [102 FWUIT: 1,000 fruit, free · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/102-fwuit): 1,000 fruit NFTs for the first 1,000 bChatX accounts, free to claim, one each. Then grab the low-hanging fruit in the FWUIT game.
- [103 Just b: our films · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/103-just-b-films): Short films that say what bWalletX is for: less noise, more life. Watch Just b, Just b 2, and b is for auteurs, business and shopkeepers.
- [104 Give your agent a wallet · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/104-give-your-agent-a-wallet): The bwalletx command-line wallet lets an AI agent pay, buy and sell for you, with daily caps and per-site pairing so it never spends more than you allow.
- [105 Airdrops · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/105-airdrops): Every bWalletX account has an airdrop address and an Airdrops inbox: unasked tokens wait there until you keep or hide them, with safety rules built in.
- [106 Bacon PoWNotes · bWalletX blog](https://bwalletx.com/blog/106-bacon-pownotes): Bacon Notes are one-of-a-kind PoWNotes that hold their own $BACON, a thank-you for bringing friends to bChatX. Minting coming soon.
